name: list_orders
description: List a customer's orders, newest first, as summaries. The response is paginated: total_matches is how many orders matched overall and next_cursor is non-null while further pages remain. Pass next_cursor back as cursor to read the next page. An order missing from one page has not been ruled out until total_matches has been accounted for.

status.description: Return only orders in this state.

since.description: Return only orders placed at or after this moment, as an ISO-8601 instant with a UTC offset, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. A bare calendar date is rejected.

limit.description: Orders per page, up to 20. Larger values are capped at 20.

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call. Omit for the first page.

error_returns.when: since is not an ISO-8601 instant or carries no UTC offset.
